_help: Act 2, McKenna's tavern: hiring Idris Mahjoub (hired_idris), 350, or 200 haggled (idris_underpaid: he resents it). His family and his city contacts (idris_contacts, Act 7) are on his rapport ladder. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act2.py.

already.speaker: idris
already.line: I am ready when you are.

first.speaker: idris
first.line: Idris Mahjoub. I guard merchants on the road south, and none of them has lost a piastre with me. Three hundred and fifty pounds.

choices.label: Haggle
choices.line: Two hundred. Take it or leave it.

joined.speaker: idris
joined.line: Then we have an agreement. I keep my agreements.

joined_cool.speaker: idris
joined_cool.line: Two hundred. I will remember it.
